items.title: Taco Bell’s Plan to Win Back Customers After Cyclospora Illness Outbreak
items.summary: Taco Bell has a battle plan to bring back customers after a parasitic outbreak was linked to lettuce served at its restaurants.  The plan includes $1 Mexican Pizzas and limited-time offers such as butter chicken tacos.  While health authorities linked an outbreak of cyclospora-related illnesses to product giant Taylor Farms, the fast-food standout has been hurt by people reporting explosive diarrhea and stomach cramping after dining at the chain’s locations.

items.title: Yum Brands' Strategic Reset Runs Into Taco Bell Trouble
items.summary: One powerful brand must recover as another departs

items.title: Fast-Casual Chain Tops Buy Point, While Lettuce Crisis Fades For Taco Bell. Starbucks Is Turning Around.
items.summary: Better-than-expected earnings sent Chipotle Mexican Grill past a buy point Thursday while Yum Brands seemed to be overcoming a lettuce-linked illness that hurt its Taco Bell chain.  Starbucks showed signs its turnaround was taking effect.  Chipotle shares jumped more than 12% to the highest level since early February.

items.title: Yum! Brands Stock Bounces Back as Taco Bell Shrugs Off Cyclosporiasis Outbreak
items.summary: Yum! Brands says Taco Bell sales are recovering after an initial slump brought on by the cyclosporiasis outbreak.

items.title: Taco Bell Works to Restore Sales Following Cyclospora Outbreak
items.summary: Taco Bell has consistently been one of the best-performing QSRs in the industry over the past several years. A U.S. public health crisis quickly interrupted that momentum. items.title: Taco Bell sales fell after cyclospora outbreak
items.summary: Taco Bell’s parent company, Yum Brands, reported robust sales and profit in the second quarter. But more recent sales took a hit after the cyclospora outbreak plunged the company’s most important brand into a food-safety crisis.

items.title: Yum! Brands Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Taco Bell Strength
items.summary: YUM tops earnings estimates as Taco Bell's strong sales and global expansion help offset softer Pizza Hut performance.

items.title: Yum Brands' sales rose last quarter, thanks to Taco Bell
items.summary: The fast-food chain operator's system sales rose 5% last quarter as it works toward completing the sale of Pizza Hut.
